tddRed.reason: New session and audit contracts were not exported before implementation
Unknown authorization audit decision was accepted before runtime validation

verifiedRules: selected role must be present in the trusted server-derived TenantScope
stale authorization versions fail on the next policy evaluation
authorization versions must be non-negative safe integers
R2 initiators cannot approve their own action
R2 requires at least one distinct approver
R3 remains disabled at the approval boundary
authorization audit records are immutable and contain request and trace IDs
object references in authorization audit records are SHA-256 digests, not raw identifiers
unapproved audit decision values fail closed
malformed audit fields, timestamps, reason codes and source applications fail closed
extra object name, vehicle plate and count fields are not copied into audit records
limitations: TEST-001 still requires an actual BFF to derive TenantScope and ignore browser tenant/role/scope values end to end.
TEST-002 still requires append-only audit persistence and readback evidence.
TEST-003 still requires a session store, revocation propagation and next-request integration evidence.
PostgreSQL RLS, identity persistence and Keycloak runtime remain prohibited until the relevant G7 gaps, ADRs and gates pass.
This is not Build, Acceptance, Release or Production Gate approval.
